packs.title: 形容詞 Level 1 第 1 組（頁碼 46-47）
packs.description: 形容詞 & 副詞 (Adjectives & Adverbs) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

short_sentences.en: The ideal candidate will have a passion for customer service.
short_sentences.zh: 理想的人選必須對客戶服務滿懷熱忱。

short_sentences.en: The company charges an annual membership fee of €55.
short_sentences.zh: 那間公司每年收取 55 歐元的會費。

short_sentences.en: This brand of shoes will be familiar to almost all female shoppers.
short_sentences.zh: 幾乎所有的女性消費者都很熟悉這個品牌的鞋子。

short_sentences.en: Let me know which day is convenient for you.
short_sentences.zh: 請讓我知道你哪一天比較方便。

words.meaning_zh: 形 整個的，全部的 / 名 全部

short_sentences.en: We spent the whole week inspecting the new software.
short_sentences.zh: 我們花了整整一週的時間檢測新軟體。

short_sentences.en: The house looks new, as the previous owner remodeled it entirely.
short_sentences.zh: 這間房子看起來很新，因為前屋主把整棟房子重新改造過了。

words.meaning_zh: 形 進一步的；更遠的 / 副 而且；再者

collocations.meaning_zh: 進一步的詳細情況；更多細節

short_sentences.en: The park is closed to the public until further notice.
short_sentences.zh: 在進一步的通知以前，本公園暫不對外開放。

words.meaning_zh: 提供資訊的，增廣見聞的

short_sentences.en: The sales seminar was both informative and motivational.
short_sentences.zh: 這場銷售研討會資訊豐富且激勵人心。

short_sentences.en: We have little time left, so please be brief.
short_sentences.zh: 我們剩下的時間不多了，請長話短說。

short_sentences.en: It was obvious that the expansion plan wouldn't work out.
short_sentences.zh: 這個擴展計畫顯然行不通。

packs.title: 形容詞 Level 1 第 2 組（頁碼 48-49）
packs.description: 形容詞 & 副詞 (Adjectives & Adverbs) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

words.meaning_zh: 形 個人的，單獨的 / 名 個人

short_sentences.en: Always keep your individual workspace clean and tidy.
short_sentences.zh: 請隨時保持個人工作空間的乾淨整齊。

words.meaning_zh: 形 總體的，全面的 / 副 全面地

short_sentences.en: The doctor assured me that my overall health is quite sound.
short_sentences.zh: 醫生向我保證我的整體健康情況十分良好。

short_sentences.en: Pay particular attention to which letters and symbols you select for your password.
short_sentences.zh: 請特別注意您選擇哪些字母和符號當密碼。

words.meaning_zh: 持續進行的，不斷發展的

short_sentences.en: The attached file contains the list of ongoing projects.
short_sentences.zh: 附件檔案涵蓋持續進行的企劃清單。

short_sentences.en: She is very punctual and never late for work.
short_sentences.zh: 她非常守時，上班從不遲到。

short_sentences.en: This job may be a bit challenging for a new hire.
short_sentences.zh: 這份工作對於新進職員來說可能會有點難度。

short_sentences.en: The accountant gave an accurate estimate of the year-end figures.
short_sentences.zh: 會計師提供年終數據的準確估計。

short_sentences.en: We should eat three complete meals a day to maintain health and energy.
short_sentences.zh: 我們一天應進食三餐來維持健康和活力。

words.meaning_zh: 形 特別喜愛的 / 名 最喜歡的東西

short_sentences.en: The Italian restaurant up the road is Jackie's favorite place to eat.
short_sentences.zh: 路邊那家義大利餐廳是傑姬最喜歡用餐的地方。

short_sentences.en: The office is small, and doesn't have an appropriate place to hold a meeting.
short_sentences.zh: 這間辦公室很小，也沒有合適的地方開會。

packs.title: 形容詞 Level 1 第 3 組（頁碼 50-51）
packs.description: 形容詞 & 副詞 (Adjectives & Adverbs) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

short_sentences.en: Many women are becoming more and more frustrated with domestic chores.
short_sentences.zh: 許多女性對於做家事感到愈來愈不滿。

words.meaning_zh: 形 完全相反的，迥異的 / 副 與…相對

collocations.meaning_zh: 跟 A 相反；在 A 對面

short_sentences.en: Bus Route 381 serves opposite sides of the city.
short_sentences.zh: 381 路公車在城市兩側往返服務。

short_sentences.en: The staff had a meeting to find a reasonable solution to the problem.
short_sentences.zh: 員工開了一場會議，欲尋找解決問題的合理方案。

short_sentences.en: Please stay on the line and the next available agent will help you.
short_sentences.zh: 請不要掛斷電話，下一位有空的接線人員將為您服務。

short_sentences.en: The contract was changed except for its essential terms.
short_sentences.zh: 合約內容除必要條款以外皆有所更動。

words.meaning_zh: 預期的；到期的；應支付的

short_sentences.en: The accountant neglected to pay the amount due on the bill.
short_sentences.zh: 會計師一時疏忽，未付清帳單上的應付金額。

short_sentences.en: There is an apparent advantage to hiring a headhunter when making a career change.
short_sentences.zh: 轉換職場跑道時，聘請獵頭的優勢顯而易見。

short_sentences.en: We received an urgent message from the boss calling for an emergency meeting.
short_sentences.zh: 我們收到老闆傳來的緊急訊息，要召開一場緊急會議。

short_sentences.en: The exchange rate remained stable throughout the week.
short_sentences.zh: 整週下來匯率相當穩定。

short_sentences.en: The retail sector is highly competitive and many shops close after one year in business.
short_sentences.zh: 零售業的競爭相當激烈，許多店家經營一年後就關門大吉了。

packs.title: 形容詞 Level 1 第 4 組（頁碼 52-53）
packs.description: 形容詞 & 副詞 (Adjectives & Adverbs) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

short_sentences.en: Those who make remarkable achievements win the Nobel Prize.
short_sentences.zh: 擁有非凡成就的人才能獲得諾貝爾獎。

words.meaning_zh: 形 潛在的；可能的 / 名 潛力，潛能

short_sentences.en: Several potential sites were considered for the new call center.
short_sentences.zh: 新客服中心的位置考量了數個潛在地點。

short_sentences.en: As the election drew near, the candidate reached a critical point in the campaign.
short_sentences.zh: 隨著大選將至，那名候選人在競選活動中迎來最重要的一刻。

short_sentences.en: The section chief is deliberate in her decision-making process.
short_sentences.zh: 課長做決策時相當深思熟慮。

short_sentences.en: The two powerful leaders had mutual respect for each other.
short_sentences.zh: 兩位強大的領導人互相敬重彼此。

words.meaning_zh: 負法律責任的；可能發生的

collocations.meaning_zh: 對 A 負有法律責任

short_sentences.en: We are not liable for accidents caused by misuse by the user.
short_sentences.zh: 對於用戶因使用不當而引起的意外事故，我們不負法律責任。

short_sentences.en: The CEO is a generous man and pays his employees well.
short_sentences.zh: 執行長是個很慷慨的人，給員工的薪資也很優渥。

short_sentences.en: The president stressed the need to follow decent business practices at all times.
short_sentences.zh: 董事長強調無論何時都需要遵循正派合宜的商業行為。

short_sentences.en: Ann has sufficient savings and can retire early.
short_sentences.zh: 安擁有充足的存款，可以提早退休。

short_sentences.en: The firm is a dedicated protector of natural resources in the region.
short_sentences.zh: 這間公司盡心盡力保護當地區域的自然資源。

packs.title: 形容詞 Level 1 第 5 組（頁碼 54-55）
packs.description: 形容詞 & 副詞 (Adjectives & Adverbs) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

short_sentences.en: The coach promised to lead his team to a championship in the upcoming season.
short_sentences.zh: 教練承諾要帶領全隊在下一個賽季中贏得冠軍。

words.meaning_zh: 形 替代的，另類的 / 名 替代品；可供選擇的事物

short_sentences.en: The first sales campaign failed so we must come up with an alternative plan for the next one.
short_sentences.zh: 由於第一次的促銷活動失敗了，所以我們得為下一場活動想出替代方案。

short_sentences.en: Jan is a competent employee and deserves a raise.
short_sentences.zh: 珍是位能幹的員工，理應得到加薪。

short_sentences.en: The boss likes to wear a conventional navy suit.
short_sentences.zh: 老闆喜歡穿傳統的藍色西裝。

short_sentences.en: Harold is a typical businessperson with a 9 to 5 job.
short_sentences.zh: 哈羅德是個典型的上班族，做著朝九晚五的工作。

short_sentences.en: The diligent manager revived the failing business.
short_sentences.zh: 那位勤奮的經理讓衰敗的企業重新振作起來。

short_sentences.en: Ms. Mansfield will be the temporary editor while Mr. Chang is on leave.
short_sentences.zh: 張先生休假期間，曼斯菲爾德小姐將擔任臨時編輯。

short_sentences.en: Alex is proving to be a hardworking and reliable assistant.
short_sentences.zh: 事實證明艾力克斯是一位認真工作又可靠的助理。

short_sentences.en: The sisters are skilled in their own respective areas of science.
short_sentences.zh: 這對姊妹精通各自的科學領域。

short_sentences.en: We spent a considerable amount of money on refurbishing the office.
short_sentences.zh: 我們花了一大筆錢整修辦公室。

packs.title: 形容詞 Level 1 第 6 組（頁碼 56-57）
packs.description: 形容詞 & 副詞 (Adjectives & Adverbs) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

words.meaning_zh: 前景看好的，大有可為的

short_sentences.en: Analysts forecast promising stock market gains for next quarter.
short_sentences.zh: 分析師預測下一季的股市將有不錯的成長。

words.meaning_zh: 形 豪華的，奢侈的 / 名 奢華；奢侈品

short_sentences.en: When Liz got a raise, she was able to afford a luxury car.
short_sentences.zh: 莉茲加薪之後就買得起豪華轎車了。

short_sentences.en: The sales manager was praised for coming up with a lucrative marketing strategy.
short_sentences.zh: 銷售經理因為想出一個獲利豐厚的行銷策略而受到讚揚。

short_sentences.en: Ms. Han is an affluent investor who is active in the stock market.
short_sentences.zh: 韓小姐是位富有的投資人，在股市中相當活躍。

short_sentences.en: Joshua has primary responsibility for guest services at the hotel.
short_sentences.zh: 約書亞主要負責旅館的顧客服務。

short_sentences.en: Paul searched for the most inexpensive flight over the internet.
short_sentences.zh: 保羅在網路上尋找最便宜的機票。

short_sentences.en: I have been searching for affordable housing for a year now.
short_sentences.zh: 我尋找買得起的房子已經找了一年了。

short_sentences.en: Aaron gave an incredible excuse for why he was late this morning.
short_sentences.zh: 亞倫為他今天早上遲到找了一個難以置信的理由。

short_sentences.en: The firm grants staff flexible work hours, with some of them telecommuting.
short_sentences.zh: 公司給員工彈性的上下班時間，某些員工甚至可以遠距工作。

short_sentences.en: Mary was finally made a member of the exclusive club.
short_sentences.zh: 瑪麗終於成為這間高級俱樂部的一員。

packs.title: 形容詞 Level 1 第 7 組（頁碼 58-59）
packs.description: 形容詞 & 副詞 (Adjectives & Adverbs) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

short_sentences.en: After the prototype was destroyed, the engineers couldn't make an equivalent model.
short_sentences.zh: 原型被破壞之後，工程師無法再做出相同的模型了。

short_sentences.en: Passengers boarding ES Flight 623 to Bucharest must hold valid passports.
short_sentences.zh: 乘坐 ES623 航班前往布加勒斯特的旅客必須攜帶有效護照。

short_sentences.en: Ken is an ambitious man who wants to climb up the corporate ladder.
short_sentences.zh: 肯懷有雄心壯志，想在公司裡一路往上爬。

short_sentences.en: Ms. Zales is reluctant to help with such a risky endeavor.
short_sentences.zh: 札萊絲小姐不願意協助進行這麼危險的嘗試。

short_sentences.en: No matter how hard we tried to convince him, the client was indifferent to our proposal.
short_sentences.zh: 無論我們多麼努力地試著說服客戶，他還是對我們的提案無動於衷。

short_sentences.en: It's difficult to penetrate the market with our current product line.
short_sentences.zh: 我們目前的產品很難打入市場。

words.meaning_zh: 一致通過的，全體一致的

short_sentences.en: The staff made a unanimous decision to set up a break room.
short_sentences.zh: 員工們一致決定布置一間休息室。

short_sentences.en: The singer gave a terrific performance and raised a lot of money for charity.
short_sentences.zh: 那位歌手的表演非常精彩，也為慈善機構募集到許多捐款。

short_sentences.en: The firm put a help-wanted ad in the paper to fill the vacant manager position.
short_sentences.zh: 那間公司在報紙上登了一則招聘廣告，想找人填補經理職缺。

short_sentences.en: I'm a bit embarrassed by all your praise.
short_sentences.zh: 您的讚美讓我覺得有點不好意思。

packs.title: 形容詞 Level 1 第 8 組（頁碼 60-61）
packs.description: 形容詞 & 副詞 (Adjectives & Adverbs) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

short_sentences.en: Customers will be delighted by our virtual try-on services.
short_sentences.zh: 顧客會很喜歡我們的虛擬試穿服務。

short_sentences.en: Some people get very nervous when they board an aircraft.
short_sentences.zh: 有些人上飛機的時候會變得非常緊張。

short_sentences.en: The dispute between the two companies is a complicated one.
short_sentences.zh: 那兩家公司之間的糾紛很複雜。

short_sentences.en: Only approved employees have access to sensitive internal information.
short_sentences.zh: 只有經核准的員工才能接觸內部機密消息。

short_sentences.en: Please be patient when waiting for a response to your inquiry.
short_sentences.zh: 請耐心等候我們回覆您的提問。

short_sentences.en: I'm seeking a permanent position, not a temporary one.
short_sentences.zh: 我想找的是固定的工作，而不是臨時的職務。

collocations.meaning_zh: 比不上 A／比 A 優秀

short_sentences.en: Mr. Danforth's low rank made him feel inferior.
short_sentences.zh: 丹佛先生因為地位低微而感到自不如人。

words.meaning_zh: 形 一夜的，過夜的 / 副 一夜

short_sentences.en: My wife left this morning for an overnight business trip.
short_sentences.zh: 我太太今天早上出門出差兩天一夜。

short_sentences.en: Ms. Kramer got a clerical job at a law firm downtown.
short_sentences.zh: 克萊默小姐在市中心的一間律師事務所找到一份文書工作。

short_sentences.en: Paper has got jammed in the copier again.
short_sentences.zh: 影印機又卡紙了。

packs.title: 形容詞 Level 1 第 9 組（頁碼 62-63）
packs.description: 形容詞 & 副詞 (Adjectives & Adverbs) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

short_sentences.en: The report predicts a significant increase in oil prices.
short_sentences.zh: 這份報告預測油價將大幅上漲。

short_sentences.en: Can you be more specific?
short_sentences.zh: 你能不能講得再明確一點？

short_sentences.en: These classes take students from elementary to advanced level.
short_sentences.zh: 這些課程幫助學生從初級學到高級。

short_sentences.en: This isn't a top brand but is fairly popular among young people.
short_sentences.zh: 雖然這不是頂級品牌，但是在年輕族群中相當受歡迎。

short_sentences.en: The boss was initially opposed to my proposal.
short_sentences.zh: 一開始，老闆反對我的提案。

short_sentences.en: Please contact the manufacturer immediately if there are any defects found in the product.
short_sentences.zh: 如果發現產品有任何瑕疵，請立即聯絡製造商。

short_sentences.en: Jan and Susan are certainly welcome to join us for dinner tonight.
short_sentences.zh: 非常歡迎珍和蘇珊今晚和我們一起共進晚餐。

short_sentences.en: Relatively affluent people tend to buy this product line.
short_sentences.zh: 往往是比較有錢的人會購買這個產品。

short_sentences.en: We sat in the back row and could hardly hear the speaker.
short_sentences.zh: 我們坐在後排，幾乎聽不到講者說什麼。

short_sentences.en: Actually, I am the manager of the Miami branch, not the Houston one.
short_sentences.zh: 事實上，我是邁阿密分公司的經理，而非休士頓分公司。

packs.title: 形容詞 Level 1 第 10 組（頁碼 64-65）
packs.description: 形容詞 & 副詞 (Adjectives & Adverbs) - LEVEL 1｜商用與軟體工程師語境｜共 10 個核心單字

short_sentences.en: After long negotiations, we eventually reached an agreement.
short_sentences.zh: 經過漫長的協商後，我們終於達成協議了。

short_sentences.en: Don't forget to send your deposit in advance; otherwise, your reservation will not be processed.
short_sentences.zh: 請記得預先支付訂金，否則將不受理您的預訂。

short_sentences.en: The CEO is hard-working; moreover, he is quite decisive.
short_sentences.zh: 執行長非常認真，而且行事也很果斷。

short_sentences.en: The climbing was difficult, but fun nevertheless.
short_sentences.zh: 登山雖然很困難，不過也很有趣。

short_sentences.en: The flight is scheduled to arrive in approximately ten hours.
short_sentences.zh: 班機預計約在十個鐘頭後抵達。

short_sentences.en: We rarely have heavy snow like this in our area.
short_sentences.zh: 我們這一帶很少會下這麼大的雪。

short_sentences.en: Why have our sales been decreasing gradually?
short_sentences.zh: 為什麼我們的銷售額逐漸往下掉了呢？

short_sentences.en: I want to meet you tomorrow morning, preferably at ten.
short_sentences.zh: 我明天早上想見你，最好是約十點碰面。

short_sentences.en: Carl is extremely good at chess and plays it every day.
short_sentences.zh: 卡爾非常擅長西洋棋，而且他天天天下。

short_sentences.en: The colleagues were understandably shocked by her sudden resignation.
short_sentences.zh: 同事們因她突然辭職而感到震驚是可以理解的。
